title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_song
caption: Chorus — Turn around. Let the old ground go. / Take one step past the things you know. / Fear can shout; let your feet reply. / One more step, and a wider sky.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_l01
caption: Narrator — She pulls him up the steep path. He struggles.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_l02
caption: Prisoner — You call this helping? I didn't ask for it.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_l03
caption: Guide — I know. Put your foot here.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_l04
caption: Prisoner — I want my answers back.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_l05
caption: Narrator — Plato makes the climb uncomfortable, even forced. The freed prisoner is furious, not grateful.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s06_l06
caption: Guide — Hold on. One step. Then argue with me.

title: Turn Around · Audio · foley-s06
caption: One More Step — sfx

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l01
caption: Narrator — Daylight. He staggers, shielding his face. The world has vanished into brightness.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l02
caption: Prisoner — You've broken my eyes!

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l03
caption: Guide — Look down. Start small.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l04
caption: Narrator — First, shadows. Then reflections in water. His eyes need time.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l05
caption: Prisoner — Who's that in the pool?

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l06
caption: Guide — You. Try not to look so disappointed.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s07_l07
caption: Narrator — He touches the water. His face breaks into ripples. He is still there.

title: Turn Around · Audio · foley-s07
caption: Too Much Light — sfx

title: Turn Around · Audio · s08_l01
caption: Narrator — Gradually, he sees the things themselves. He walks around an olive tree.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s08_l02
caption: Prisoner — It has a back! Everything has a back!

title: Turn Around · Audio · s08_l03
caption: Guide — You'd be surprised how often people forget that.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s08_l04
caption: Narrator — Night comes. Moon and stars are easier to face than daylight.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s08_l05
caption: Prisoner — I thought darkness meant nothing was there.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s08_l06
caption: Narrator — Shadow, reflection, object, sky. Each discovery prepares his eyes for the next.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s09_song
caption: Chorus — Turn around. Let the daylight through. / Nothing ends where the shadows do. / There is more than we ever knew. / Room for questions, and room for you.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s09_l01
caption: Narrator — At last he understands the sun: daylight, growth, seasons. The source behind the visible world.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s09_l02
caption: Prisoner — The light isn't just another thing. It lets me see.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s09_l03
caption: Guide — Now you're asking a different kind of question.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s09_l04
caption: Narrator — For Plato, the sun represents the Good: what makes truth and understanding possible.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s09_l05
caption: Prisoner — And I thought I knew everything about a jar.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s10_l01
caption: Narrator — He thinks of the cave. Its prizes seem small. His friends don't.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s10_l02
caption: Prisoner — They'll be arguing about the horse right now.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s10_l03
caption: Guide — You could stay.

title: Turn Around · Audio · s10_l04
caption: Prisoner — And leave them? I was wrong beside them. They didn't stop being my friends.
